scenario: An investigative journalist researching executive pay practices at a pharmaceutical company uses SEC EDGAR to retrieve recent compensation filings, applies financial growth calculations to the reported figures, and compiles the results into a structured investigative report for editorial review.
info_flow: sec-watcher retrieves EDGAR proxy/10-K filings and structures compensation data with signal annotations → financial-calculator computes year-over-year growth multiples from the reported figures → reporting drafts an investigative exposé summarizing the findings.
